```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(mice)
library(WeightIt)
library(cobalt)

options(scipen = 999)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PURPOSE
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sensitivity analyses for the locked primary entropy-balancing ATT design.
#
# PRIMARY ANALYSIS (07b; not re-estimated here):
#   Full sample, mean-only entropy-balancing ATT, original 23 covariates.
#
# SENSITIVITY A: SUPPORT-RESTRICTED ATT
#   - Restrict both groups to rel_duration <= 5.
#   - Re-estimate entropy-balancing ATT weights.
#   - Balance the original 23 covariates PLUS I(F_age^2).
#   - The quadratic female-age term was added after diagnostics showed that
#     F_age was the only systematic residual KS imbalance in this sensitivity
#     analysis. Across all 20 imputations it improved F_age distributional
#     balance without materially worsening ESS or weight tails.
#
# SENSITIVITY B: OVERLAP WEIGHTING
#   - Keep the unrestricted full sample.
#   - Use logistic propensity-score overlap weighting (ATO).
#   - Use the original 23 covariates ONLY.
#   - I(F_age^2) is deliberately NOT included because adding it produced
#     estimated propensity scores numerically equal to 0 or 1 (separation).
#
# These are sensitivity analyses only and do not replace 07b.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

IMP_PATH <- here("data", "derived", "mice_imp_final.rds")
PRIMARY_DIAG_PATH <- here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_diagnostics_by_imputation.csv")
OUTPUT_DIR <- here("data", "derived")

stopifnot(file.exists(IMP_PATH))

imp <- readRDS(IMP_PATH)

stopifnot(
  inherits(imp, "mids"),
  imp$m == 20L,
  imp$iteration == 20L
)

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

completed_list <- complete(imp, action = "all")

stopifnot(length(completed_list) == 20L)

cat("Loaded final MICE object.\n")
cat("Imputations:", imp$m, "\n")
cat("Iterations:", imp$iteration, "\n")
```

## 1. Weighting specifications

```{r}
BASE_FORMULA <- group_w ~
  hinc +
  hgowner +
  size +
  smallspace +
  livedhere +
  east +
  hhgr +
  rel_duration +
  syear +
  M_age +
  M_life_sat +
  M_germborn +
  M_migration +
  M_germcitz +
  M_employment +
  M_edu_level +
  F_age +
  F_life_sat +
  F_germborn +
  F_migration +
  F_germcitz +
  F_employment +
  F_edu_level

SUPPORT_FORMULA <- update(
  BASE_FORMULA,
  . ~ . + I(F_age^2)
)

base_covariates <- all.vars(BASE_FORMULA)[-1]

stopifnot(
  length(base_covariates) == 23L,
  !anyDuplicated(base_covariates)
)

cat("Base covariates:", length(base_covariates), "\n")
cat("\nBase formula:\n")
print(BASE_FORMULA)
cat("\nSupport-restricted formula:\n")
print(SUPPORT_FORMULA)
```

## 2. Helper functions

```{r}
effective_n <- function(w) {
  (sum(w)^2) / sum(w^2)
}

prepare_group <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    mutate(
      group_num = as.numeric(as.character(group)),
      group_w = factor(
        group_num,
        levels = c(0, 1),
        labels = c("control", "parent")
      )
    )
}

extract_balance <- function(w, imp_number, sensitivity_name) {

  b <- cobalt::bal.tab(
    w,
    un = TRUE,
    stats = c("m", "v", "ks"),
    s.d.denom = "pooled",
    continuous = "std",
    binary = "std",
    poly = 2
  )

  b$Balance %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("component") %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      sensitivity = sensitivity_name,
      imp = imp_number,
      is_polynomial_term = grepl("²|\\^2|I\\(.*\\^2\\)", component),
      .before = 1
    )
}

make_diag <- function(d, w, balance_table, imp_number, sensitivity_name) {

  ww <- w$weights
  parent_w <- ww[d$group_w == "parent"]
  control_w <- ww[d$group_w == "control"]

  bal_original <- balance_table %>%
    filter(!is_polynomial_term)

  vr <- bal_original$V.Ratio.Adj[
    !is.na(bal_original$V.Ratio.Adj)
  ]

  tibble(
    sensitivity = sensitivity_name,
    imp = imp_number,

    n_parent = sum(d$group_w == "parent"),
    n_control = sum(d$group_w == "control"),

    parent_ESS = effective_n(parent_w),
    control_ESS = effective_n(control_w),

    parent_weight_min = min(parent_w),
    parent_weight_median = median(parent_w),
    parent_weight_p99 = quantile(parent_w, .99),
    parent_weight_max = max(parent_w),

    control_weight_min = min(control_w),
    control_weight_median = median(control_w),
    control_weight_p95 = quantile(control_w, .95),
    control_weight_p99 = quantile(control_w, .99),
    control_weight_max = max(control_w),

    max_abs_SMD_original = max(abs(bal_original$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_original_SMD_gt_05 = sum(abs(bal_original$Diff.Adj) > .05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_original_SMD_gt_10 = sum(abs(bal_original$Diff.Adj) > .10, na.rm = TRUE),

    max_KS_original = max(bal_original$KS.Adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_original_KS_gt_10 = sum(bal_original$KS.Adj > .10, na.rm = TRUE),

    min_variance_ratio = min(vr, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_variance_ratio = max(vr, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_variance_ratio_below_05 = sum(vr < .5),
    n_variance_ratio_above_2 = sum(vr > 2),

    n_control_gt_5 = sum(control_w > 5),
    n_control_gt_10 = sum(control_w > 10),
    n_control_gt_20 = sum(control_w > 20)
  )
}
```

## 3. Input checks

```{r}
for (i in seq_along(completed_list)) {

  d <- completed_list[[i]]

  stopifnot(
    nrow(d) == 1602L,
    !anyNA(d[, c("group", base_covariates)])
  )
}

cat(
  "PASS: all 20 completed datasets contain 1602 couples and no missing weighting covariates.\n"
)
```

## 4. Sensitivity A: support-restricted entropy ATT + female-age quadratic term

Controls in the current design have baseline relationship duration from 0 to 5 years. This analysis therefore restricts both groups to `rel_duration <= 5`, removing parent couples outside direct relationship-duration support. The same entropy-ATT specification is then re-estimated, with an additional `F_age^2` balance constraint to address the residual female-age distributional imbalance identified during diagnostics.

```{r}
support_models <- vector("list", imp$m)
support_weighted <- vector("list", imp$m)
support_balance <- vector("list", imp$m)
support_diag <- vector("list", imp$m)
support_warnings <- vector("list", imp$m)

for (i in seq_len(imp$m)) {

  d <- completed_list[[i]] %>%
    prepare_group() %>%
    filter(rel_duration <= 5)

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(d[, c("group_w", base_covariates)]),
    sum(d$group_w == "parent") == 641L,
    sum(d$group_w == "control") == 893L
  )

  fit_warnings <- character(0)

  w <- withCallingHandlers(
    weightit(
      SUPPORT_FORMULA,
      data = d,
      method = "ebal",
      estimand = "ATT",
      focal = "parent"
    ),
    warning = function(x) {
      fit_warnings <<- c(fit_warnings, conditionMessage(x))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  stopifnot(
    length(w$weights) == nrow(d),
    all(is.finite(w$weights)),
    all(w$weights > 0)
  )

  bal <- extract_balance(
    w,
    imp_number = i,
    sensitivity_name = "ATT entropy: rel_duration <= 5 + F_age^2"
  )

  support_models[[i]] <- w
  support_balance[[i]] <- bal

  support_diag[[i]] <- make_diag(
    d,
    w,
    bal,
    imp_number = i,
    sensitivity_name = "ATT entropy: rel_duration <= 5 + F_age^2"
  ) %>%
    mutate(n_warnings = length(fit_warnings))

  support_warnings[[i]] <- tibble(
    sensitivity = "ATT entropy: rel_duration <= 5 + F_age^2",
    imp = i,
    warning_text = ifelse(
      length(fit_warnings) == 0,
      NA_character_,
      paste(unique(fit_warnings), collapse = " | ")
    )
  )

  support_weighted[[i]] <- d %>%
    mutate(
      .imp = i,
      weight_sensitivity = w$weights,
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

## 5. Sensitivity B: unrestricted overlap weighting

This analysis retains all 709 parent and 893 control couples and targets the overlap population (ATO). The original 23-covariate logistic propensity-score specification is retained. A quadratic female-age term is deliberately not included because testing it produced propensity scores numerically equal to 0 or 1, indicating separation.

```{r}
ato_models <- vector("list", imp$m)
ato_weighted <- vector("list", imp$m)
ato_balance <- vector("list", imp$m)
ato_diag <- vector("list", imp$m)
ato_warnings <- vector("list", imp$m)

for (i in seq_len(imp$m)) {

  d <- completed_list[[i]] %>%
    prepare_group()

  stopifnot(
    nrow(d) == 1602L,
    sum(d$group_w == "parent") == 709L,
    sum(d$group_w == "control") == 893L,
    !anyNA(d[, c("group_w", base_covariates)])
  )

  fit_warnings <- character(0)

  w <- withCallingHandlers(
    weightit(
      BASE_FORMULA,
      data = d,
      method = "glm",
      estimand = "ATO"
    ),
    warning = function(x) {
      fit_warnings <<- c(fit_warnings, conditionMessage(x))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  stopifnot(
    length(w$weights) == nrow(d),
    all(is.finite(w$weights)),
    all(w$weights > 0)
  )

  bal <- extract_balance(
    w,
    imp_number = i,
    sensitivity_name = "GLM overlap weighting: full sample"
  )

  ato_models[[i]] <- w
  ato_balance[[i]] <- bal

  ato_diag[[i]] <- make_diag(
    d,
    w,
    bal,
    imp_number = i,
    sensitivity_name = "GLM overlap weighting: full sample"
  ) %>%
    mutate(n_warnings = length(fit_warnings))

  ato_warnings[[i]] <- tibble(
    sensitivity = "GLM overlap weighting: full sample",
    imp = i,
    warning_text = ifelse(
      length(fit_warnings) == 0,
      NA_character_,
      paste(unique(fit_warnings), collapse = " | ")
    )
  )

  ato_weighted[[i]] <- d %>%
    mutate(
      .imp = i,
      weight_sensitivity = w$weights,
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

## 6. Combine diagnostics

```{r}
support_diag_df <- bind_rows(support_diag)
ato_diag_df <- bind_rows(ato_diag)

sensitivity_diagnostics <- bind_rows(
  support_diag_df,
  ato_diag_df
)

sensitivity_balance <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(support_balance),
  bind_rows(ato_balance)
)

sensitivity_warnings <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(support_warnings),
  bind_rows(ato_warnings)
)

cat(
  "Total sensitivity-analysis warnings:",
  sum(sensitivity_diagnostics$n_warnings),
  "\n"
)

if (any(sensitivity_diagnostics$n_warnings > 0)) {
  print(
    sensitivity_warnings %>%
      filter(!is.na(warning_text)),
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )
}
```

## 7. Across-imputation summary

```{r}
sensitivity_summary <- sensitivity_diagnostics %>%
  group_by(sensitivity) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parent = first(n_parent),
    n_control = first(n_control),

    min_parent_ESS = min(parent_ESS),
    median_parent_ESS = median(parent_ESS),

    min_control_ESS = min(control_ESS),
    median_control_ESS = median(control_ESS),

    max_control_weight = max(control_weight_max),
    max_parent_weight = max(parent_weight_max),

    max_abs_SMD = max(max_abs_SMD_original),
    max_n_SMD_gt_10 = max(n_original_SMD_gt_10),

    max_KS = max(max_KS_original),
    max_n_KS_gt_10 = max(n_original_KS_gt_10),

    min_variance_ratio = min(min_variance_ratio),
    max_variance_ratio = max(max_variance_ratio),
    max_n_VR_below_05 = max(n_variance_ratio_below_05),
    max_n_VR_above_2 = max(n_variance_ratio_above_2),

    max_n_control_gt_5 = max(n_control_gt_5),
    max_n_control_gt_10 = max(n_control_gt_10),
    max_n_control_gt_20 = max(n_control_gt_20),

    total_warnings = sum(n_warnings),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(
  sensitivity_summary,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)
```

## 8. Female-age diagnostic

```{r}
female_age_balance <- sensitivity_balance %>%
  filter(component == "F_age") %>%
  select(
    sensitivity,
    imp,
    Diff.Adj,
    V.Ratio.Adj,
    KS.Adj
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    sensitivity,
    imp
  )

print(
  female_age_balance,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)
```

## 9. Any remaining original-variable diagnostic flags

```{r}
diagnostic_flags <- sensitivity_balance %>%
  filter(!is_polynomial_term) %>%
  filter(
    abs(Diff.Adj) > .10 |
      (
        !is.na(V.Ratio.Adj) &
          (V.Ratio.Adj < .5 | V.Ratio.Adj > 2)
      ) |
      KS.Adj > .10
  ) %>%
  select(
    sensitivity,
    imp,
    component,
    Diff.Adj,
    V.Ratio.Adj,
    KS.Adj
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    sensitivity,
    desc(KS.Adj)
  )

print(
  diagnostic_flags,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)
```

## 10. Compare with locked primary entropy ATT

```{r}
if (file.exists(PRIMARY_DIAG_PATH)) {

  primary_diag <- read_csv(
    PRIMARY_DIAG_PATH,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  primary_summary <- primary_diag %>%
    summarise(
      sensitivity = "PRIMARY: entropy ATT, full sample",

      n_parent = first(n_parent),
      n_control = first(n_control),

      min_parent_ESS = min(parent_ESS),
      median_parent_ESS = median(parent_ESS),

      min_control_ESS = min(control_ESS),
      median_control_ESS = median(control_ESS),

      max_control_weight = max(control_max),
      max_parent_weight = max(parent_weight_max),

      max_abs_SMD = max(max_abs_SMD_original),
      max_n_SMD_gt_10 = max(n_original_SMD_gt_10),

      max_KS = max(max_KS_original),
      max_n_KS_gt_10 = max(n_original_KS_gt_10)
    )

  comparison_table <- bind_rows(
    primary_summary,
    sensitivity_summary %>%
      select(
        sensitivity,
        n_parent,
        n_control,
        min_parent_ESS,
        median_parent_ESS,
        min_control_ESS,
        median_control_ESS,
        max_control_weight,
        max_parent_weight,
        max_abs_SMD,
        max_n_SMD_gt_10,
        max_KS,
        max_n_KS_gt_10
      )
  )

  print(
    comparison_table,
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )
}
```
